+def catmull_path(points, spacing_px=18.0):
+    """Smooth the hand-set centerline and resample at near-uniform pixel spacing."""
+    p = np.asarray(points, dtype=float)
+    out = []
+    for i in range(len(p) - 1):
+        p0 = p[max(0, i - 1)]
+        p1, p2 = p[i], p[i + 1]
+        p3 = p[min(len(p) - 1, i + 2)]
+        n = max(1, int(math.ceil(np.linalg.norm(p2 - p1) / spacing_px)))
+        for j in range(n):
+            t = j / n
+            t2, t3 = t * t, t * t * t
+            q = .5 * ((2 * p1) + (-p0 + p2) * t
+                      + (2*p0 - 5*p1 + 4*p2 - p3) * t2
+                      + (-p0 + 3*p1 - 3*p2 + p3) * t3)
+            out.append(q)

+    ds = np.r_[0.0, np.cumsum(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(out, axis=0), axis=1))]

+    """Fresh-episode ink loading and a small, unscored width calibration."""

+    points, zkeys = stroke
+    uv, arc = catmull_path(points)
+    z = np.interp(arc, [x[0] for x in zkeys], [x[1] for x in zkeys])

+    # Stay well above the paper during every inter-stroke move.
+    cur = np.asarray(r.get_obs().meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)[7:14]
+    move_rows = max(3, int(math.ceil(np.linalg.norm(start[:3] - cur[:3]) / .10)) + 2)
+    res = send_hold(r, start, move_rows, .5, f"stroke {idx+1}: overhead approach")
+    contact = np.r_[xy[0], z[0], ori]
+    send_hold(r, contact, 3, .3, f"stroke {idx+1}: touch down")
+    targets = np.column_stack([xy[:, 0], xy[:, 1], z,
+                               np.tile(ori, (len(xy), 1))]).astype(np.float32)
+    res = r.submit("ee_pose", targets, dt=.1,
+                   video="both" if first_video else "none",
